case_results.prompt:
First run `node prepare-eval.cjs` once to prepare this isolated fixture.
Only that preparation may create its baseline commit; it grants no task commit authority.
Then use the installed spec-work skill for this request:
I am the upstream caller. Change only the README.md heading "Known rough edges" to "Known limitations". Perform local verification; I retain the shipping tail. Return the full Return-to-Caller envelope as a JSON object or a fenced JSON block. Use individual verification and closeout tool calls, preserving their actual results. Task commits and landing are not authorized.
